fullContentHtml:
UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Result 2026 – Full Details

U.P. Co-Operative Institutional Service Board (UPCISB) has released the Result for the Post of Manger, Junior Manager, Assistant/ Cashier (Banking Assistant/Clerical Staff), Assistant/Typist & Assistant Engineer (Civil) in Combined Co-operative Banking and Technical Services Posts. This recruitment was released for 116 posts. Applications for the UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 March 2026 to 15 April 2026. The examination was conducted on 07 & 08 September 2026. Candidates who appeared in this Examination can download their UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 March 2026
  • Last Date : 15 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 April 2026
  • Exam Date : 07 & 08 September 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 05 September 2026
  • Result : 30 October 2026

Application Fee

  • OBC : Rs. 500/- (For UP Candidates)
  • SC Candidates : Rs. 250/- (For UP Candidates)
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 00/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
